title: Control message spelled as a boolean `control` field

source.note: composed: §6.3 speaks of "a message which has the control field set to true", which is a different spelling from §5.1.1's MessageType value. Both are accepted.

message.content: Please share your rate control policies.

expect.text: Please share your rate control policies.

notes: ECMA-430 never defines a `control` field in §5.1; it appears only in §6.3's prose and in TR/113's figures. The crate accepts both spellings and preserves whichever arrived.
